pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.

pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.1.4: mālāvacchaṃ ropentipi ropāpentipi. siñcantipi siñcāpentipi. ocinantipi ocināpentipi. ganthentipi ganthāpentipi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.1.5: ekatovaṇṭikamālaṃ karontipi kārāpentipi. ubhatovaṇṭikamālaṃ karontipi kārāpentipi.

pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu kāsīsu vassaṃ vuttho sāvatthiṃ gacchanto bhagavantaṃ dassanāya yena kīṭāgiri tadavasari.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.3.2: atha kho so bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya kīṭāgiriṃ piṇḍāya pāvisi
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.3.3: pāsādikena abhikkantena paṭikkantena ālokitena vilokitena samiñjitena pasāritena okkhittacakkhū iriyāpathasampanno.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.3.4: manussā taṃ bhikkhuṃ passitvā evamāhaṃsu: “kvāyaṃ abalabalo viya mandamando viya bhākuṭikabhākuṭiko viya, ko imassa upagatassa piṇḍakampi dassati. amhākaṃ pana ayyā assajipunabbasukā saṇhā sakhilā sukhasambhāsā mihitapubbaṅgamā ehisvāgatavādino abbhākuṭikā uttānamukhā pubbabhāsino. tesaṃ kho nāma piṇḍo dātabbo”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.3.5: addasā kho aññataro upāsako taṃ bhikkhuṃ kīṭāgirismiṃ piṇḍāya carantaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.3.6: disvāna yena so bhikkhu tenupasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ bhikkhuṃ abhivādetvā etadavoca: “api bhante piṇḍo labbhatī”ti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.4.1: atha kho so upāsako taṃ bhikkhuṃ gharaṃ netvā bhojetvā etadavoca:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.4.3: “sāvatthiṃ kho ahaṃ āvuso gamissāmi bhagavantaṃ dassanāyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.4.4: “tena hi bhante mama vacanena bhagavato pāde sirasā vandāhi, evañca vadehi:”
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.4.6: assajipunabbasukā nāma kīṭāgirismiṃ āvāsikā alajjino pāpabhikkhū.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.4.8: mālāvacchaṃ ropentipi ropāpentipi …pe… vividhampi anācāraṃ ācaranti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.4.9: yepi te bhante manussā pubbe saddhā ahesuṃ pasannā, tepi etarahi assaddhā appasannā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.4.10: yānipi tāni saṅghassa pubbe dānapathāni, tānipi etarahi upacchinnāni.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.4.12: sādhu bhante bhagavā kīṭāgiriṃ bhikkhū pahiṇeyya yathāyaṃ kīṭāgirismiṃ āvāso saṇṭhaheyyā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.5.1: “evamāvuso”ti kho so bhikkhu tassa upāsakassa paṭissutvā yena sāvatthi tena pakkāmi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.5.2: anupubbena yena sāvatthi jetavanaṃ anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāmo, yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.5.3: āciṇṇaṃ kho panetaṃ buddhānaṃ bhagavantānaṃ āgantukehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ paṭisammodituṃ.

pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.1: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sannipātāpetvā bhikkhū paṭipucchi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.2: “saccaṃ kira bhikkhave assajipunabbasukā nāma kīṭāgirismiṃ āvāsikā alajjino pāpabhikkhū, te evarūpaṃ anācāraṃ ācaranti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.3: mālāvacchaṃ ropentipi ropāpentipi …pe… vividhampi anācāraṃ ācaranti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.4: yepi te bhikkhave manussā pubbe saddhā ahesuṃ pasannā, tepi etarahi assaddhā appasannā.

pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.19: hatthismimpi sikkhissanti, assasmimpi sikkhissanti, rathasmimpi sikkhissanti, dhanusmimpi sikkhissanti, tharusmimpi sikkhissanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.20: hatthissapi purato dhāvissanti, assassapi purato dhāvissanti, rathassapi purato dhāvissanti, dhāvissantipi adhāvissantipi,

pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.25: “gacchatha tumhe sāriputtā kīṭāgiriṃ, gantvā assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kīṭāgirismā pabbājanīyakammaṃ karotha, tumhākaṃ ete saddhivihārikā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.26: “kathaṃ mayaṃ bhante assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kīṭāgirismā pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoma. caṇḍā te bhikkhū pharusā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.6.27: “tena hi tumhe sāriputtā bahukehi bhikkhūhi saddhiṃ gacchathā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.4: āpattiṃ ropetvā byattena bhikkhunā paṭibalena saṅgho ñāpetabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.6: ime assajipunabbasukā bhikkhū kuladūsakā pāpasamācārā. imesaṃ pāpakā samācārā dissanti ceva suyyanti ca. kulāni ca imehi duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.7: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kīṭāgirismā pabbājanīyakammaṃ kareyya, na assajipunabbasukehi bhikkhūhi kīṭāgirismiṃ vatthabba”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.10: ime assajipunabbasukā bhikkhū kuladūsakā pāpasamācārā, imesaṃ pāpakā samācārā dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, kulāni ca imehi duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.11: saṅgho assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kīṭāgirismā pabbājanīyakammaṃ karoti, na assajipunabbasukehi bhikkhūhi kīṭāgirismiṃ vatthabbanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.12: yassāyasmato khamati assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kīṭāgirismā pabbājanīyakammassa karaṇaṃ; na assajipunabbasukehi bhikkhūhi kīṭāgirismiṃ vatthabbanti, so tuṇhassa,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.16: kataṃ saṅghena assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kīṭāgirismā pabbājanīyakammaṃ, na assajipunabbasukehi bhikkhūhi kīṭāgirismiṃ vatthabbanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.7.17: khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti. –
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.1: atha kho sāriputtamoggallānappamukho bhikkhusaṅgho kīṭāgiriṃ gantvā assajipunabbasukānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ kīṭāgirismiṃ pabbājanīyakammaṃ akāsi: “na assajipunabbasukehi bhikkhūhi kīṭāgirismiṃ vatthabba”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.2: te saṅghena pabbājaniyakammakatā na sammā vattanti, na lomaṃ pātenti, na netthāraṃ vattanti, na bhikkhū khamāpenti, akkosanti, paribhāsanti chandagāmitā dosagāmitā mohagāmitā bhayagāmitā pāpenti. pakkamantipi. vibbhamantipi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.3: ye te bhikkhū appicchā te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.4: “kathaṃ hi nāma assajipunabbasukā bhikkhū saṅghena pabbājaniyakammakatā na sammā vattissanti na lomaṃ pātessanti, na netthāraṃ vattissanti, bhikkhū na khamāpessanti, akkosissanti, paribhāsissanti, chandagāmitā dosagāmitā mohagāmitā bhayagāmitā pāpessanti, pakkamissantipi vibbhamissantipī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.5: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato etamatthaṃ ārocesuṃ. …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.6: “saccaṃ kira bhikkhave assajipunabbasukā bhikkhū saṅghena pabbājaniyakammakatā na sammā vattanti …pe… vibbhamantipī”ti?
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.8: vigarahi buddho bhagavā …pe… kathaṃ hi nāma te bhikkhave moghapurisā saṅghena pabbājaniyakammakatā na sammā vattissanti, na lomaṃ pātessanti, na netthāraṃ vattissanti bhikkhū na khamāpessanti. akkosissanti, paribhāsissanti, chandagāmitā dosagāmitā mohagāmitā bhayagāmitā pāpessanti, pakkamissantipi vibbhamissanti’pi. netaṃ bhikkhave appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.9: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.10.1: “bhikkhu paneva aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vā upanissāya viharati kuladūsako pāpasamācāro. tassa kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, kulāni ca tena duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.12: “āyasmā kho kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, āyasmato kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, kulāni cāyasmatā duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, pakkamatāyasmā imamhā āvāsā, alante idha vāsenā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.13: evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno te bhikkhū evaṃ vadeyya:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.14: “chandagāmino ca bhikkhū dosagāmino ca bhikkhū mohagāmino ca bhikkhū bhayagāmino ca bhikkhū, tādisikāya āpattiyā ekaccaṃ pabbājenti: ekaccaṃ na pabbājentī”ti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.16: “mā āyasmā evaṃ avaca, na ca bhikkhū chandagāmino na ca bhikkhū dosagāmino na ca bhikkhū mohagāmino na ca bhikkhū bhayagāmino,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.17: āyasmā kho kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, āyasmato kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti ceva suyyanti ca’ kulāni cāyasmatā duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca pakkamatāyasmā imamhā āvāsā, alaṃ te idha vāsenā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.18: evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno tatheva paggaṇheyya, so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi yāva tatiyaṃ samanubhāsitabbo tassa paṭinissaggāya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.19: yāva tatiyañce samanubhāsiyamāno taṃ paṭinissajjeyya, iccetaṃ kusalaṃ,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.1: bhikkhu paneva aññataraṃ gāmaṃ vā nigamaṃ vāti
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.2: gāmopi nigamopi nagarampi gāmo ceva nigamo ca.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.6: cattāri kulāni: khattiyakulaṃ brāhmaṇakulaṃ vessakulaṃ suddakulaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.8: kulāni dūseti pupphena vā phalena vā cuṇṇena vā mattikāya vā dantakaṭṭhena vā veḷunā vā vejjikāya vā jaṅghapesanikena vā.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.10: mālāvacchaṃ ropetipi ropāpetipi, siñcatipi siñcāpetipi, ocinātipi ocināpetipi, ganthetipi ganthāpetipi. …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.12: ye saṃmukhā te passanti, ye tirokkhā te suṇanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.14: pubbe saddhā hutvā taṃ āgamma assaddhā honti, pasannā hutvā appasannā honti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.16: ye saṃmukhā te passanti, ye tirokkhā te suṇanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.20: aññehi bhikkhūhi. ye passanti ye suṇanti. tehi vattabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.21: “āyasmā kho kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, āyasmato kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, kulāni cāyasmatā duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, pakkamatāyasmā imamhā āvāsā, alaṃ te idha vāsenā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.22: evañca so bhikkhu bhikkhūhi vuccamāno te bhikkhū evaṃ vadeyya: “chandagāmino ca bhikkhū dosagāmino ca bhikkhu mohagāmino ca bhikkhū bhayagāmino ca bhikkhū. tādisikāya āpattiyā ekaccaṃ pabbājenti ekaccaṃ na pabbājentī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.26: aññehi bhikkhūhi. ye passanti, suṇanti, tehi vattabbo:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.27: “mā āyasmā evaṃ avaca, na ca bhikkhū chandagāmino na ca bhikkhū dosagāmino, na ca bhikkhū mohagāmino na ca bhikkhū bhayagāmino;
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.28: āyasmā kho kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, āyasmato kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, kulāni cāyasmatā duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, pakkamatāyasmā imamhā āvāsā alaṃ te idha vāsenā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.35: “mā āyasmā evaṃ avaca, na ca bhikkhū chandagāmino na ca bhikkhū dosagāmino na ca bhikkhū mohagāmino na ca bhikkhū bhayagāmino,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.36: āyasmā kho kuladūsako pāpasamācāro, āyasmato kho pāpakā samācārā dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, kulāni cāyasmatā duṭṭhāni dissanti ceva suyyanti ca, pakkamatāyasmā imamhā āvāsā, alaṃ te idha vāsenā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.45: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu saṅghena pabbājanīyakammakato bhikkhū chandagāmitā dosagāmitā mohagāmitā bhayagāmitā pāpeti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.47: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāseyya tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.50: ayaṃ itthannāmo bhikkhu saṅghena pabbājanīyakammakato bhikkhū chandagāmitā dosagāmitā mohagāmitā bhayagāmitā pāpeti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.52: saṅgho itthannāmaṃ bhikkhuṃ samanubhāsati tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.53: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa bhikkhuno samanubhāsanā, tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya. so tuṇhassa, yassa nakkhamati, so bhāseyya:
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.56: samanubhaṭṭho saṅghena itthannāmo bhikkhu tassa vatthussa paṭinissaggāya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.57: khamati saṅghassa, tasmā tuṇhī, evametaṃ dhārayāmī”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.61: saṅghādisesaṃ ajjhāpajjantassa ñattiyā dukkaṭaṃ, dvīhi kammavācāhi thullaccayā paṭippassambhanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.63: saṅghova tassā āpattiyā parivāsaṃ deti mūlāya paṭikassati, mānattaṃ deti abbheti, na sambahulā, na ekapuggalo. tena vuccati saṅghādisesoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:2.64: tasseva āpattinikāyassa nāmakammaṃ adhivacanaṃ. tenapi vuccati saṅghādisesoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:3.1.1: dhammakamme dhammakammasaññī na paṭinissajati, āpatti saṅghādisesassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:3.1.2: dhammakamme vematiko na paṭinissajati, āpatti saṅghādisesassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:3.1.3: dhammakamme adhammakammasaññī na paṭinissajjati, āpatti saṅghādisesassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:3.2.7: uddiṭṭhā kho āyasmanto terasa saṅghādisesā dhammā, nava paṭhamāpattikā, cattāro yāvatatiyakā,
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:3.2.8: yesaṃ bhikkhu aññataraṃ vā aññataraṃ vā āpajjitvā yāvatīhaṃ jānaṃ paṭicchādeti tāvatīhaṃ tena bhikkhunā akāmā parivatthabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:3.2.9: parivutthaparivāsena bhikkhunā uttari chārattaṃ bhikkhumānattāya paṭipajjitabbaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:3.2.10: ciṇṇamānatto bhikkhu yattha siyā vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho, tattha so bhikkhu abbhetabbo.
pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:3.2.11: ekenapi ce ūno vīsatigaṇo bhikkhusaṅgho taṃ bhikkhuṃ abbheyya, so ca bhikkhu anabbhito. te ca bhikkhū gārayhā. ayaṃ tattha sāmīci.
